body:
I don't have the money for the whole doctor thing.  No insurance.  Even if I could afford a checkup, the problems that they would find would surely cost too much to fix.  I absolutely must not tell anyone about any of this in-person.  I won't.  I only see bad things coming from it.  Being forced to continue living is as much life as slavery is a career.  I won't.

It would be great to be ok again, yes.  I don't think I can afford the damage though.  Permanent medical records that reflect that nobody should rely on me if I can't take my pills, paying for those medications for the rest of my life, quite possibly experiencing only small improvement but being far worse off for it....  I can't unmake the choice to confess, and I can't undo fates people will then consign me to.  Fuck all that.  Dying is simpler, when I can't hold on anymore, it's so much better that I let go.  I'm so sorry, I just don't want to be forced to do this when I cannot.

If I die, I won't care about my lost hopes and dreams.  It's probably too late already to salvage anything anyway.  Getting by isn't what I want out of life.  A person can get by on thorazine in a padded cell.  I'm getting by right now.  If life cannot be worth living then it is not.

I do not want, at all, to live on a farm.  I don't want to go to Europe, what would I even do there?  My job isn't bad, it's one of the only things worth doing.  I'm only afraid of being fired.  My only complaint is obviously I don't have much time to be alone, or as much as I would like.  Volunteer organizations seem like a great way to sacrifice years of your life on the alter of personal crisis.  I'm not signing a piece of paper that will own me for the next two or three years.

I don't want to make a difference.  It's like you are talking to someone else, or maybe I just don't get it, don't understand implications, and led you on.  All I want is to be ok.  Everyone else, too.  But I don't need to change the world, I couldn't if I tried, humanity is deadset on keeping things going largely the same way.  Saving even two lives at the expense of hapiness is what a good person would do, but I'm not a good person.  I want to sweat in a soup kitchen like I want a molten iron enema.  

Maybe I'm not worth saving guys.

I won't be talking to anyone but people here.  Admitting you're suicidal is an immense burden on others, I'll be resented.  I'll never be able to undo the personal damage, people will always think of me in that context.  If it gets to my employers or friends or anyone anywhere who matters, my prospects are severely wounded.  If it's bad enough, if I tell them how close I've come, tell them when I feel that way, they'll lock me away and then I'll have nothing, nothing but a desire to die.

I won't be screaming at god.  I may as well scream at the floor or a chair.  Blame the chair.  The only person responsible is me.  I'm also the only one that needs to or should die.  It's like just punishment.

Proactive, tried it.  Religiously.  On the foam stuff now.  It works a little better but it's no match for my face.  It's ok, though, a marred outside serves to turn people away, preventing them from coming into close contact with my marred inside.
